title: One pair of rabbits, one year – how many pairs?
description:
In his Liber Abaci of 1202, Leonardo of Pisa – better known as Fibonacci – posed a famous puzzle: one pair of rabbits in a walled place. How many pairs after a year? The answer gives the Fibonacci sequence: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 … all the way to 377. Scholars in India knew these numbers centuries earlier.

One true story from the history of math – every day.
Created with AI assistance (animation and voice); facts from the sources listed.

Sources:
